title_en: Where are my coins? Exchange vs wallet
title_zh: 币到底在哪：交易所和钱包有什么不同？
goal_en: Tell a custodial exchange account from a self-custody wallet, and understand who controls access and who handles recovery.
goal_zh: 能区分托管交易账户与自托管钱包，理解控制权与恢复责任。

shots.visual_en: Sam's phone hits the floor; Sam grabs it in panic while ghost coins scatter from the screen.
shots.visual_zh: 手机掉到地上，小白惊慌地捡起：屏幕里的硬币幻影散开。

lines.en: My phone broke. Are my coins smashed too?
lines.zh: 手机坏了，币是不是也一起摔没了？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E03' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第03集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Where are my coins? Exchange vs wallet
onscreen_text_zh: 币到底在哪：交易所和钱包有什么不同？

shots.visual_en: The phone shrinks into a window; behind it, an abstract on-chain ledger. A key controls the permission to act.
shots.visual_zh: 手机缩成一扇窗口，窗口后是抽象链上账本；钥匙控制操作权限。

lines.en: Your coins aren't inside your phone. A wallet lets you see assets on the blockchain and uses keys to approve actions. Whether you can recover depends on the wallet type and the recovery options you kept.
lines.zh: 不是把硬币装进手机。钱包帮你查看链上资产，并用密钥授权操作。能否恢复，取决于你用什么钱包、保留了哪些恢复方式。

shots.visual_en: Split screen. Left: the platform holds the keys; the user logs in to see a balance. Right: the user holds the recovery credentials.
shots.visual_zh: 左边为平台保管钥匙、用户登录看余额；右边为用户保管恢复凭证。

lines.en: With a custodial exchange account, the platform mainly manages the assets and keys, and you act through your account. With a self-custody wallet, you control the credentials. Convenience and responsibility are split differently.
lines.zh: 交易所托管账户主要由平台管理底层资产与密钥，你用账户操作。自托管钱包则由你负责控制凭证；使用方便与责任分配不同。

onscreen_text_zh: 自托管：你保管恢复凭证

shots.visual_en: Exchange side shows an 'Account recovery' support entry; a standard recovery-phrase wallet shows 'Restore from your own backup'.
shots.visual_zh: 交易所显示“找回账户”客服入口；普通助记词钱包显示“使用自己的备份恢复”。

lines.en: Forget your password on either one, and you just call support?
lines.zh: 两边忘记密码都找客服？

lines.en: Don't think of it that way. With a standard recovery-phrase wallet, if you lose the phrase and have no other valid recovery method, support can't get it back for you.
lines.zh: 不能这样想。普通助记词钱包的恢复凭证丢失，且没有其他有效恢复方式时，客服无法替你找回。

onscreen_text_en: Wallet: restore from your own backup
onscreen_text_zh: 钱包：用自己的备份恢复

shots.visual_en: Three risk cards: platform risk, leaked credentials, wrong approvals. Not arranged as a safety ranking.
shots.visual_zh: 三张风险牌分别是平台风险、凭证泄露、错误授权，不排列成绝对安全排名。

lines.en: Keeping assets on a platform carries platform risk. Holding them yourself can go wrong through a leaked key or a bad approval. Today, just understand the difference. You don't need to move everything right now.
lines.zh: 放在平台有平台风险，自己保管也会因泄露密钥或错误授权损失。今天只理解区别，不要求你立刻搬走所有资产。

shots.visual_en: Drag-and-drop: 'Platform custody' and 'You keep the recovery credentials' are dropped onto the matching scenes.
shots.visual_zh: 用户将“平台托管”和“自己保管恢复凭证”拖到对应场景。

lines.en: Who controls the permission to move the assets? Answer that first. Then decide which account or wallet you need.
lines.zh: 谁在控制资产的操作权限？先回答这件事，再决定你需要哪种账户或钱包。

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: Two doors look the same. One is fake. Next episode: how to spot the real one.
lines.zh: 两扇门一模一样，其中一扇是假的。下一集：怎么认出真门。

onscreen_text_en: Two doors look the same. One is fake. Next episode: how to spot the real one.
onscreen_text_zh: 两扇门一模一样，其中一扇是假的。下一集：怎么认出真门。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。
onscreen_text_en: One verified gateway to the world's exchanges
onscreen_text_zh: 全球交易所，一个官方入口

end_hook.en: Two doors look the same. One is fake. Next episode: how to spot the real one.
end_hook.zh: 两扇门一模一样，其中一扇是假的。下一集：怎么认出真门。

exercise.task_en: Match two scenarios: an exchange login account, and a standard recovery-phrase self-custody wallet.
exercise.task_zh: 匹配两个场景：交易所登录账户；普通助记词自托管钱包。
exercise.answer_en: They differ in who has control and how recovery works. Self-custody does not mean automatically safe.
exercise.answer_zh: 两者控制权和恢复机制不同；自托管不等于自动安全。

red_lines: Recovery-phrase rules apply only to that wallet type ｜ 助记词规则仅用于相应钱包类型
Don't describe social-recovery or MPC wallets as the same mechanism ｜ 不把所有社交恢复、多方计算钱包说成同一机制
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
